description: SET condition-name TO FALSE (ISO 14.9.39 Format 4 - the FALSE arm). 14.9.39.4 GR7 places 'the literal in the FALSE phrase of the VALUE clause associated with condition-name-1' in the conditional variable, and 14.9.39.3 SR7 requires that phrase to be there (COBOL2049). A COBOL-2002 addition on the same derived authority as its VALUE-clause half (value-false-phrase-2002): COBOL-85's Format 4 has the TRUE arm only. Recognition-fired by VersionConformancePass.ParseArm.VisitSetBooleanStatement on the FALSE_ token, so the gate survives the SR7 refusal. The row's source necessarily writes the VALUE phrase too, so below 2002 BOTH gates fire - the matrix asserts presence of the code, not its multiplicity. kb/Work PB555.
vcr: SET condition-name TO FALSE (COBOL-2002); A1 authority-sufficiency gap (D18)
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. VMSETFA.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 CV PIC 9 VALUE 1.
   88 CN VALUE 1 WHEN SET TO FALSE IS 7.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    SET CN TO FALSE.
    DISPLAY CV.
    STOP RUN.
